definitions.explanation: Tiny drops of liquid scattered into the air — from splashing water, a wave, or from coughing and sneezing. Widely known from {飛沫感染|ひまつかんせん} (droplet transmission of disease).

examples.japanese: ⟦{波|なみ}→波：00868_nami⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{飛沫|ひまつ}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦かかった→かかる：00711_kakaru⟧。
examples.english: I got sprayed by the waves.

examples.japanese: ⟦くしゃみ→くしゃみ：04428_kushami⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{飛沫|ひまつ}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{飛|と}び{散|ち}る→飛び散る：09645_tobichiru⟧。

⟦マスク→マスク：05075_masuku⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧、⟦{咳|せき}→咳：12007_seki⟧や⟦くしゃみ→くしゃみ：04428_kushami⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{飛沫|ひまつ}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{周|まわ}り→周り：01732_mawari⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{広|ひろ}がる→広がる：01980_hirogaru⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{防|ふせ}ぐ→防ぐ：02409_fusegu⟧。
examples.english: A mask prevents the droplets from coughs and sneezes from spreading to those around you.

notes:
Fine drops of liquid flung into the air, whether from water or from the mouth and nose.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {飛沫|ひまつ}⟦{感染|かんせん}→感染：05977_kansen⟧: droplet infection
- {飛沫|ひまつ}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{飛|と}ぶ→飛ぶ：00759_tobu⟧: droplets fly
- ⟦{波|なみ}→波：00868_nami⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{飛沫|ひまつ}: sea spray

USAGE:
The same kanji is read しぶき in everyday contexts (a splash of water); ひまつ is the more technical reading used especially for disease transmission.
